solution.title: Google Workspace + Gemini Enterprise Target Architecture Blueprint (Enterprise/150k+)

products.name: Google Workspace + Gemini Enterprise Target Architecture Blueprint (Enterprise/150k+) — Commercial
products.short_description: Define and own the end-state Google Workspace + Gemini + identity architecture for a 150k-user transformation — principles for collaboration, Drive replacement, identity, governance, and AI — so it stays scalable, supportable, and under enterprise control. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Own the end-state before the vendors start building

In a 150k-user shift from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace and Gemini, whoever owns the target architecture owns the outcome. This blueprint defines the end-state Google Workspace + Gemini + identity architecture and the architectural principles that govern every workstream — email/calendar/collaboration, Drive replacement, identity integration, data governance/retention, and AI enablement — so the transformation stays scalable, supportable, and under enterprise control rather than fragmenting across partners.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Architecture Overview — the end-state Google Workspace + Gemini + identity architecture and how the workstreams fit together, with the enterprise principles that constrain every design.
  • Architecture Domains — principles and reference patterns for email/calendar/collaboration, Drive / SharePoint replacement, identity integration (Entra ID / SSO / provisioning), data governance & retention (Vault / Purview coexistence), and AI enablement (Gemini + agentic).
  • Decision Records & Standards — a reusable set of architecture decision records (ADRs), non-functional requirements, and enterprise standards the program measures designs against.
  • 5 assessment/validation scripts — current-state discovery across the M365/Entra source, an architecture-conformance validation, a coverage/gap report, safe remediation guidance, and a scope/target-group helper.
  • Governance hooks & a Target-Architecture document template — how the blueprint feeds the Architecture Review Board, plus Testing/validation gates and Best Practices for keeping the architecture authoritative.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An approved, stable enterprise target architecture — every workstream aligned to one end-state design — so migration waves execute without architectural rework.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • GWARCH-Discovery.ps1 — read-only current-state discovery of the M365/Entra source estate for the target-architecture blueprint
    • GWARCH-Remediation.ps1 — safe, guidance-first remediation for architecture-conformance gaps (defaults to -WhatIf)
    • GWARCH-Report.ps1 — read-only coverage/gap report rolling discovery + validation into an ARB-ready view
    • GWARCH-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — map source Entra groups to the GWARCH-Scope taxonomy (defaults to -WhatIf)
    • GWARCH-Validation.ps1 — read-only architecture-conformance checks against the M365/Entra source estate

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
